title: lotus flower stick incense burner
text: lotus flower stick incense burner. This is a lovely, but sturdy little lotus flower that will burn the skinny incense sticks.  Because the flower is so sturdy, it is easy to clean.  It is also striking in a the black ceramic plate.  The lotus is a shiny glaze.  The black plate is a satin finish.  About 4" in diameter, including the black base.
